name: personal_library-mcp
description: MCP server in Go for federated search, citation and reading of books, papers, comics, magazines and standards — querying the the primary catalog catalog alongside open-access discovery (AA, arXiv, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, Crossref, OpenLibrary, Project Gutenberg, dblp, PubMed, ERIC) and article downloads from Unpaywall, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, bioRxiv/medRxiv, the RFC Editor, NIST, Schloss Dagstuhl, the ACL Anthology, Zenodo, SciELO, the FAO Knowledge Repository, Internet Archive Scholar, CORE, Crossref and OAPEN. Four focused tools (search, get_details, download, read), one static binary, no account required.
